q: What does the Hooghly mixed industries cluster use in energy?
title: Hooghly mixed cluster: energy and CO2
short: About 105,800 toe a year in 2022-23: 853 million kWh of electricity and 46,300 t of coal, furnace oil, LDO and LSHS, across 950 MSMEs and 50 large units. At today's grid factor the electricity alone is about 576,000 t CO2, so for most Hooghly units the power bill sets the footprint.
audience: Foundries, rolling mills, engineering and chemical units in Konnagar, Serampore, Dankuni, Bhadreswar and Chandannagar

ul: Foundries for engineering, railway and auto buyers; rolling mills making billets, pipes, tubes and coils.
Engineering units making tractor and auto parts, farm and industrial machinery, and jewellery.
Chemical units making rubber, resin, FRP and antioxidants.
By contract demand: 850 units below 300 kVA, 100 at 300 to 1,500 kVA, 50 above.
Micro and small: about 302,500 kWh and almost no fuel.
Medium: about 1.55 million kWh and 1,471 t of fuel.
Large: about 8.8 million kWh and 1,637 t of fuel.
Induction melting: 600 to 770 kWh per tonne, in crucibles of 500 kg to 5 t.
Forging furnaces: 100 to 180 litres of oil per tonne; heat treatment 100 to 150.
Reheating furnaces for rolling run on pulverised coal and LDO at 1,100 to 1,200 C, often with the fuel control bypassed.
Chemical unit boilers burn coal, wood or rice husk at about 55% efficiency, mostly without economisers.
A lid on the induction crucible: open crucibles lose 4 to 6% of input as radiation; a lid saves up to 3% and pays back within months.
IE3 motors on lathes, presses and drills.
Plug compressed air leaks at joints and valves.

example.title: The cluster and two units (estimate)
lines: Electricity: 853 million kWh x 0.675 = about 575,800 t CO2
Fuel: 46,300 t at 1.76 (all Indian coal) = 81,500 t, or at 3.13 (all furnace oil) = 144,900 t
Medium unit: 1.55 million kWh = 1,048 t, plus 1,471 t of fuel = 2,590 to 4,600 t
One tonne melted in an induction furnace at 700 kWh: 473 kg CO2
example.note: Energy from TERI's 2022-23 energy profile of the cluster. The fuel is a mix the profile does not split, so its CO2 is shown as a range; your own fuel bills fix it.

senseible: Senseible reads your electricity bills and coal, furnace oil and diesel invoices into dated records with their CO2, so a medium unit sees its power and fuel lines side by side.
